picks.name: S.A.M.
picks.source_note: New label discovery: Kalahari Oyster Cult. Similar deep, hypnotic house/techno territory to your Fort Romeau and Hodge picks.
picks.bio: "L.W.Y.S." (September 25, 2026, Kalahari Oyster Cult) is a vinyl-only, single-sided pressing with an engraved B-side -- a Bandcamp & One Eye Witness exclusive from the Copenhagen/Amsterdam-linked producer.
picks.why_listen: A rare, tightly-controlled single-track release built for the format -- a collector's cut with real weight for anyone tracking Kalahari Oyster Cult's output.

picks.name: Bicep
picks.source_note: New artist discovery: self-associated with Ninja Tune. Similar melodic house/techno territory to your Overmono and Fort Romeau picks.
picks.bio: "Air / Lemonder / Viper" (September 25, 2026, Ninja Tune) is Bicep's first new music of the year -- a three-track EP featuring SOARR and Warp producer Clark with Saskia, paired with a three-part short film following UK free party crews across 24 hours.
picks.why_listen: A high-profile return from one of dance music's biggest crossover acts -- 'Air' and 'Viper' bring widescreen, festival-ready melodic house/techno energy for a peak-time stretch.
